title: AUTH-062 access acquisition race

assertionSteps.title: 1. Given User A is authenticated as user-a in an isolated browser context

steps.title: Install clock "Tue Jan 01 2030 07:59:00 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
Pause clock "Tue Jan 01 2030 08:00:00 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"

assertionSteps.title: 2. And the selected fixture tab is labelled "WS-A" inside the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page
3. And access A expires at controlled time T+900 seconds; no refresh credential exists
4. And acquisition for access A is pending; accepted extension installs access B
5. And the browser is visible; request counts restart after access B is installed
6. When the browser changes this page from visible to hidden
7. Then the access-A acquisition AbortSignal is aborted
8. And the browser records exactly 1 new POST requests to "/api/auth/v2/sso/refreshtoken"
9. And the new acquisition POST body has singleUIAuthorization equal to access B
10. When the fixture accepts the access-B acquisition
11. And the browser changes this page from hidden to visible
12. Then the tab labelled "WS-A" inside the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page is visible

steps.title: One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".

assertionSteps.title: 13. And the installed access credential remains access B

annotations.description: Actual MFE with controlled HTTP responses, clock, visibility and popup boundary. Browser-only unsigned credentials. No real provider or server security acceptance.
